R1:
If you want to see whether you're opted in: the switch is "Connected Content apps" under Personal Intelligence.

Google Account > Data & privacy > Personalization settings > Manage Personalized Recommendations in Search Services.

Disconnecting stops new sharing.
R2:
For the receipt, it's one added clause. The policy used to stop at "...based on your content from Drive, Gmail, or Photos."

Since Oct 16 it continues: "unless you choose to make data from these services available to other Google services that support personalized ads."
R3:
Most people won't remember. Fastest check: Google Account > Data & privacy > Personalization settings, then look for "Connected Content apps" under Personal Intelligence.

If Gmail or Photos shows as connected, that's the exception in play.
R4: Nice, that's about as locked down as it gets. If Connected Content apps is greyed out for you, nothing is being shared through it.
